name: Woody
description: Dry, earthy woods: cedar, sandalwood, vetiver.

name: Woody Spicy
description: Woods warmed with pepper, cardamom or clove.

name: Chypre
description: Citrus top over a mossy, woody base (oakmoss, patchouli).

name: Leather
description: Smoky, tarry, suede or leather-goods accords.

name: Oud
description: Agarwood — dark, resinous, animalic.

name: Citrus
description: Zesty bergamot, lemon, orange, grapefruit.

name: Hesperidic Cologne
description: Classic eau de cologne structure: citrus, neroli, herbs.

name: Aromatic
description: Herbs like lavender, sage and rosemary.

name: Fougère
description: Lavender, coumarin and oakmoss — the barbershop classic.

name: Aromatic Fougère
description: Modern fougère with fresh herbs and woods.

name: Oriental
description: Warm resins, amber, vanilla and spice (also called Amber).

name: Amber
description: Labdanum, benzoin and vanilla warmth.

name: Spicy
description: Cinnamon, clove, saffron, pepper-forward.

name: Gourmand
description: Edible notes: vanilla, caramel, coffee, praline.

name: Tobacco
description: Sweet, honeyed tobacco leaf.

name: Fresh
description: Clean, airy, light compositions.

name: Aquatic
description: Marine, ozonic, sea-spray notes.

name: Green
description: Cut grass, leaves, galbanum, violet leaf.

name: Fresh Spicy
description: Bright spices (ginger, pink pepper) with citrus.

name: Floral
description: Rose, jasmine, lily — flowers at the heart.

name: White Floral
description: Tuberose, jasmine, orange blossom, gardenia.

name: Floral Fruity
description: Flowers with sweet fruit.

name: Fruity
description: Non-citrus fruit: berries, apple, pear, peach.

name: Powdery
description: Iris, violet, heliotrope — soft cosmetic powder.

name: Musky
description: Clean or skin-like musks.
